applicability: UHC Commercial plans that have elected weight-loss medication coverage (optional program). Section 2 (general). North Dakota fully insured EHB variant (Section 3, BMI >= 40) NOT modeled. Plans without weight-loss coverage fall to Non-Formulary Wegovy (P 1445-4; no weight-management pathway).

criteria.description: Patient is >= 12 years of age (Wegovy injection). All cohort patients are adults.
criteria.source_quote: (1) Patient is ≥ 12 years of age (for Qsymia, Saxenda, Wegovy injection and Xenical)
criteria.interpretation_notes: Age from Patient.birthDate on the request date.

criteria.description: Treatment requested for appetite suppression or weight loss.
criteria.source_quote: One of the following: (1) Treatment is being requested for appetite suppression or weight loss

criteria.description: Drug will be used as an adjunct to lifestyle modification (diet/caloric restriction, exercise, behavioral support, or community-based program). No minimum duration, no prior-completion requirement.
criteria.source_quote: Used as an adjunct to lifestyle modification (e.g., dietary or caloric restriction, exercise, behavioral support, community-based program)
criteria.interpretation_notes: Any ONE form of ongoing/planned lifestyle modification suffices ('e.g.' list). Judged from the most recent documentation: explicitly not following any diet/exercise plan fails; no lifestyle documentation at all is insufficient; a single diet-only or exercise-only effort that is ongoing passes. USER-APPROVED (2026-09-29): must be documented — no lifestyle documentation near the request is INSUFFICIENT; explicit non-adherence is FAIL; any single ongoing modality passes. Operationalization (2026-09-29): 'near the request' = documentation dated within 180 days before the request date; older lifestyle documentation alone is INSUFFICIENT.

criteria.description: BMI >= 30, OR BMI >= 27 AND a weight-related comorbidity.
criteria.source_quote: One of the following: (1) Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 30 kg/m2 or for pediatric patients a BMI > 95th percentile -OR- (2) Both of the following: (a) BMI ≥ 27 kg/m2 -AND- (b) Patient has a weight-related comorbidity (e.g., dyslipidemia, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, sleep apnea)
criteria.interpretation_notes: Same BMI and comorbidity logic as other policies. USER-APPROVED (2026-09-29): latest recorded structured BMI governs; elevated BP without diagnosis is CONFLICT.
